decisions.reason: The existing message-184 MODIFY already replaces the one-click prize-claim wording with automatic wallet transfer and adds the supplied fiat-buyer rewards section; no further update or removal is required.
The existing message-184 MODIFY already changes the About-page prize copy to automatic wallet payout and excludes visible or one-click redemption controls.
Changing prize collection from manual claiming to automatic wallet transfer does not alter the existing Chainlink VRF winner-selection behavior.
Automatic transfer of winnings does not necessarily change whether prize-pool funds use Aave for yield, and the source makes no Aave decision.
Referral commissions were already automatic, immediate wallet payments; the source changes prize collection rather than the coded-referral commission rule.
The source repeats the existing Big Block amount and draw interval but changes only post-win collection, which is owned by the separate prize-claim Requirement.
The source repeats the existing Small Block amount and draw interval but does not change the Small Block mechanism; automatic payout belongs to the prize-claim flow.
Automatic transfer of a winner's prize does not change ticket eligibility, expiration, burning, reset, or carry-forward behavior.
The existing message-184 MODIFY already records the Transak wallet-provisioning and mint-destination changes; prize payout behavior belongs to the separate prize-claim Requirement.
The source describes automatic prize receipt for a winner but does not change what book access, referral identity, badges, or prize tickets follow an NFT transfer.
The prize payout-mode change does not alter ticket allocation when a mint has no referral code.
The source retains the $30 mint and $10 referral commission and does not change the mint-price allocation or prize-pool destinations.
